questions.prompt: What must you do with a dead animal in Fairbanks within 24 hours?
choices: Take it to an animal shelter.
Call the director of public safety immediately.
Leave it for the city to clean up.
Bury it or dispose of it inside the city.
questions.answer: Take it to an animal shelter.
questions.excerpt:
Footnotes: --- ( 1 ) --- Editor's note— Regulations regarding animals in the Fairbanks North Star Borough Code, chapter 6,
               entitled "Animals," are applicable in the city. Cross reference— Health, ch. 34.

It shall be unlawful for any person to stall-feed any cattle, sheep or hogs or keep
               them in any manner for the purpose of fattening the animal within the city. (Code 1960, § 10.228)

The owner of any animal which may die within the city shall, within 24 hours after
               its death, remove and bury the animal outside the city limits or, alternatively, provide
               for disposition of the animal at an animal shelter. If any person shall fail to comply
               with the provisions of this section and shall fail to remove any dead animal belonging
               to him, the director of public safety shall make such disposal of the animal as the
               law directs; and the costs of such disposal shall be recovered of such owner by action
               before the magistrate, with costs of suit. It shall be the duty of the director of
               public safety to remove all dead animals at the cost of the city when the owner is
               unknown or refuses or fails to comply with this provision, and to prosecute all persons
               violating this section. (Code 1960, § 10.230) Cross reference— Solid waste, ch. 66 .

Failure of a dog or cat owner to remove the excrement deposited by his dog or cat
               on any public way or on another person's property is made a minor offense under Chapter 46 , Article IV, Division 3 Littering, Section 46-162 (10). ( Ord. No. 6010, § 3, 5-28-2016 )
